verdict.rationale: Circle documents an official Circle CLI under its Agent Stack. It is described as a single command interface to create and manage wallets, transfer, swap and bridge USDC, execute smart contracts, and discover or pay for services, and the probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. Its placement in the agent stack fits the AI-native framing, but the evidence covers only the CLI's scope, not its depth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, details on installation, authentication and agent-friendly output (e.g. machine-readable/JSON modes).
